approval: User agreement 2026-10-19: justified borrowing, explicit effective assumptions and constrained fits permitted; no new mechanisms, cell merging or default switch
notes: Each presynaptic effective input passes Hill nonlinearity before the original W. No added biological cells, contacts or per-contact dynamic states.
Only fixed nonnegative W, fixed shared contact tau per target cell and common postsynaptic driving force admit this reduction.
e0 is an explicit weighted aggregate in [0,row_sum(W)], not necessarily a unit gate. Whole-cell maximal excitatory conductance is gE * row_sum(W).
ON uses row_sum(W)-Wf(u). No normalization, no reuse of old checkpoint as adapted state. All 103 numerical coefficients remain unbound.
